ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~15%) to low-intensity pixels (~85%) across the ventral surface, with high-intensity pixels localized to circular anomalies and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) field with discrete, high-contrast white circular ring coordinates distributed across the medial and lateral zones; dense clusters of high-intensity (white) spherical geometries at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Prominent U-shaped central notch with a wide, rounded vertex and approximately 50-degree aperture between the intersecting lobe trajectories.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and periodic jagged peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward sweep towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial distribution of circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) across the entire ventral area; massive clusters of three-dimensional white spherical protrusions (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear disruption visible on the right lobe, medial section, approximately 20 degrees from the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and numerous circular pigmentation losses (scars) distributed bilaterally.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion density at the far edges of the trailing boundary, accentuated by protruding biological attachments.
